title: Pithyx catalog index v1
description: `index.json` at the root of a catalog's branch `catalog` (channel `stable`) or `catalog-next` (channel `beta`), written only by the catalog's CI (D328). It lists every published version of every app with the SHA-256 of each file the box reads, so the signature over this file (`index.json.sig`, `index-signature.v1.schema.json`) covers them all. The files of a version lie in `apps/<id>/<version>/`: `pithyx.json` (`manifest`), `icon.svg` (`icon`), `screenshots/<name>` and the package `<id>-<version>.pithyxapp` without image tarballs (`package`); its images are linked by digest. A published version is never changed or removed. Readers ignore fields they do not know, so a new optional field is a minor change; anything else raises `indexVersion`, which a box refuses when it does not know it.

catalog.description: The `id` of the catalog's `catalog.json`. A box refuses an index of another catalog, so a signed index cannot be passed off as another catalog's.

channel.description: `stable` for the branch `catalog`, `beta` for `catalog-next`. A box refuses an index of a channel other than its own, and trusts a signing key only for the channels it is built in for.

sequence.description: Raised by one with every publish of this catalog and channel. A box remembers the highest sequence it verified per catalog and channel and refuses a lower one, so an old index cannot be replayed.

apps.description: Every app of the catalog by id.

Timestamp.description: A time in UTC as ISO 8601 with seconds, for example `2026-10-08T19:00:00Z`.

Sha256.description: A SHA-256 as 64 lowercase hex digits.

File.description: A file of the version, by the SHA-256 and the size of its exact bytes. A box refuses a file that differs.

Screenshot.description: A screenshot in `apps/<id>/<version>/screenshots/<name>`, shown in the order of the list. The extension gives the media type: `png` image/png, `jpg` image/jpeg, `webp` image/webp.

Platform.description: An image for one architecture, as in `backend/images.lock.json`.

manifest.description: The digest of the image manifest for this architecture.

config.description: The digest of the image config, which Docker shows as the image id.

Version.description: A published version of an app.

manifest.description: `apps/<id>/<version>/pithyx.json`, the same bytes as in the package.

icon.description: `apps/<id>/<version>/icon.svg`, the same bytes as in the package.

images.description: The backend's images as `backend/images.lock.json` of the package lists them: one entry per image reference of its Compose file, pinned by digest, with the platform manifest and config digest per architecture. Absent for an app without a backend.

architectures.description: The architectures the version runs on, `amd64` and `arm64`; every image must have each of them. A box ignores names it does not know and lists the version only when its own architecture is here.

pithyx.description: The manifest's `pithyx` range, or `*` when the manifest has none, in the same syntax. A box lists the version only when its own version is in the range, so it never has to read a manifest it is too old for.

dataVersion.description: The manifest's `dataVersion`, absent when it has none. It never goes down from one version to the next.

source.description: Where the source of this version is: the catalog repository, the commit of `master` that CI built, and the app's folder `apps/<id>`. The Store links to it.

versions.description: Every published version by its SemVer version.
